description: This file defines the PdfDocumentInformation class, which manages the metadata (such as title, author, subject, keywords, creator, producer, creation and modification dates) of a PDF document within the PDFsharp library. It inherits from PdfDictionary and provides properties to access and modify document info entries.

classes.name: PdfDocumentInformation
classes.description: Represents the PDF document information dictionary, providing access to metadata fields such as title, author, subject, etc.

methods.name: PdfDocumentInformation
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with a PdfDocument or a PdfDictionary.

methods.name: Title
methods.description: Gets or sets the document’s title.

methods.name: Author
methods.description: Gets or sets the name of the person who created the document.

methods.name: Subject
methods.description: Gets or sets the subject of the document.

methods.name: Keywords
methods.description: Gets or sets keywords associated with the document.

methods.name: Creator
methods.description: Gets or sets the name of the application that created the document.

methods.name: Producer
methods.description: Gets the producer application of the PDF.

methods.name: CreationDate
methods.description: Gets or sets the creation date of the document.

methods.name: ModificationDate
methods.description: Gets or sets the modification date of the document.
